title_zh: 美团：本地生活服务平台
title_en: Chinese Companies (9/20): Meituan, the Platform for Everyday Local Services
note_en: 取得 "achieve, obtain" is the verb Chinese uses with abstract nouns like 成功, 成绩, and 进展: 但都没有取得很大成功 "but none of them had achieved much success." Here 成功 is a noun, so it needs a verb to carry it, just as English says "achieve success" rather than just "succeed". Note also that 都 comes before the negative 没有 to mean "none of them": 都没有 "all ... not," whereas 没有都 would mean "not all."
